details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1542-1589 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: fetch_canary_to_tmp and fetch_pr_head_sha use bare gh api calls without the retry wrapper, so transient GitHub API failures can hard-fail Phase 4b.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers independently identified the same lack of retry protection on the helper fetches, which bypasses the retry budget intended for infrastructure flakiness.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1600-1670 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The retry polling loop does not check whether the PR was closed or merged while waiting for a rerun.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the loop can keep polling and dispatching against a closed PR, wasting CI time and producing misleading timeout/fetch failures.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1687-1696 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Any non-zero run_pytest exit is reported as spec_mismatch, even when the failure is a harness/configuration error such as fixture RuntimeError from missing env vars.
  WHY: Several reviewers agreed this misclassifies infrastructure failures as editor/content bugs, misleading operators about the true root cause.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:23-37 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The canary_invocation fixture declares a request parameter that is never used.
  WHY: Multiple reviewers called out the parameter as dead code/noise; it does not affect runtime behavior.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1661-1663 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The jq expression in the retry poll loop has invalid nested quoting around the null fallback.
  WHY: These reviewers all asserted the filter will fail to parse at runtime, causing polling to never find candidates; severity is kept at the highest reported level.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1708-1712 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: Phase 5 is skipped when Phase 4b hard-fails, contradicting the claim that later phases still execute regardless of Phase 4b outcome.
  WHY: Reviewers agreed the workflow’s default success gating means a Phase 4b failure prevents later phases from running, though this behavior may be intentional.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1586-1591 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The retry dispatch hardcodes internal-review.yml as the workflow target.
  WHY: This single reviewer warned that repositories without that exact workflow name will get workflow-not-found errors and fail retry dispatch.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:2578-2585 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The success_after_retry path does not explicitly exit 0 after echoing success.
  WHY: Reviewers noted this is asymmetrical and confusing, but it is not a runtime failure because the shell still exits successfully.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1663 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The jq filter’s bash-variable interpolation could be unsafe in a more general setting.
  WHY: This reviewer treated the variable expansion as technically unsafe, though they noted it is not a bug with the current SHA input shape.
- scripts/review_apply_fixes.sh:191-228 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The E2E smoke override prompt docs still refer to a single bait line despite the multi-line corruption change.
  WHY: The reviewer described this as stale documentation that could mislead future editor instances, with no runtime impact.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1663 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The jq expression at line 1663 is not a bug.
  WHY: The reviewer explicitly tested the exact escaping and concluded it parses and executes correctly, so this is a dismissed false positive that still must be preserved in the per-reviewer section.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1708-1712 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The claim that Phases 5/6/7 should continue regardless of Phase 4b failure is not the actual issue; the real issue is the misleading summary behavior.
  WHY: The reviewer stated hard-fail after retry exhaustion is intentional, but the phase-skipping summary can still be misleading.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1542-1565 and 1573-1589 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: fetch_canary_to_tmp and fetch_pr_head_sha use bare gh api calls without retry.
  WHY: A transient 5xx or connection error in either fetch function can hard-fail Phase 4b instead of using the retry budget intended to absorb infrastructure flakes.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1693-1696 and tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:42-47 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The canary fixture RuntimeError path is misclassified as spec_mismatch.
  WHY: Missing workflow env vars make the fixture raise RuntimeError, but the shell wrapper maps any run_pytest failure to spec_mismatch and blames the editor.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:23 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The request parameter is declared but never referenced in the fixture body.
  WHY: It is dead code with no runtime impact, although Pytest convention makes the signature superficially plausible.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1661 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq expression in the retry poll loop has nested quoting that causes a syntax error.
  WHY: The reviewer tested the exact expression and concluded jq receives malformed syntax, so the retry polling loop cannot match workflow runs.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1539 and 1564 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: fetch_canary_to_tmp and fetch_pr_head_sha use bare gh api calls without the gh_api_with_retry wrapper.
  WHY: Transient GitHub API failures would produce fetch_failed or pr_head_fetch_failed instead of being retried.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1659-1680 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The retry polling loop never checks whether the PR was closed while waiting.
  WHY: If the PR closes during the wait, the workflow continues polling and dispatching against a closed PR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1695 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any run_pytest failure is reported as spec_mismatch.
  WHY: Fixture RuntimeError and other infrastructure errors are incorrectly treated as content mismatches.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:~1482 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The Phase 4b step lacks continue-on-error: true, so later phases are skipped when it fails.
  WHY: The reviewer said the default success gating prevents Phases 5/6/7 from running and makes the summary misleading.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:23 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The request parameter in the canary_invocation fixture is unused.
  WHY: This is dead code and adds noise.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1711 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The success_after_retry path does not explicitly exit 0.
  WHY: The reviewer considered the asymmetry confusing, though not functionally broken.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1663 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq expression contains improperly escaped nested quotes.
  WHY: The reviewer asserted the inner \"null\" becomes invalid jq syntax and causes the retry polling loop to fail.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1693-1696 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: run_pytest failures caused by fixture RuntimeError are classified as spec_mismatch.
  WHY: Harness misconfiguration gets mislabeled as an editor/content bug, obscuring the real root cause.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1600-1670 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The polling loop does not check whether the PR was closed during the 10-minute wait.
  WHY: The reviewer said it wastes API calls and can produce a misleading retry_timeout for a stale PR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1542-1565 and 1573-1589 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Both fetch helper functions call bare gh api without retry.
  WHY: A transient API failure can abort canary/PR-head fetching and bypass the retry budget.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:23 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The request parameter is declared but never used.
  WHY: It is dead code and only adds confusion.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1662-1663 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq expression at the retry poll loop is not a bug.
  WHY: The reviewer tested the exact expression and found it compiles and produces correct output, so they rejected the cross-pollination claim.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1693-1696 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Any pytest failure after retry is classified as spec_mismatch, including harness/infrastructure failures.
  WHY: Fixture RuntimeError and file I/O errors are not editor/content bugs, so the status misleads operators.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1600-1670 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The 10-minute wait-for-retry-run loop never checks whether the PR was closed.
  WHY: The reviewer said it wastes CI time and can burn rate-limit budget while polling a stale PR.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1542-1589 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The fetch helper functions use bare gh api calls without retry.
  WHY: A transient 429/5xx during canary or PR-head fetch aborts Phase 4b instead of retrying.
- tests/test_e2e_editor_smoke_canary.py:23 | severity=low | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The request parameter in the fixture signature is unused.
  WHY: It adds noise but does not affect runtime behavior.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1686-1696 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: The retry path could still fail due to stale canary data because fetch_canary_to_tmp has no cache-busting mechanism.
  WHY: The reviewer suggested the GitHub Contents API could return stale cached data and cause a misleading spec_mismatch.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM x-ai_grok-4_1-fast ===
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1663 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The jq filter in the retry poll loop has a syntax error from unescaped nested double-quotes around null.
  WHY: The reviewer said jq parse fails every poll iteration, leaving CANDIDATES empty and forcing retry_timeout.
- .github/workflows/test-and-mark-stable.yml:1542-1565 and 1573-1589 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The helper fetch functions use bare gh api without the gh_api_with_retry wrapper.
  WHY: Transient 429/5xx errors would immediately fail Phase 4b instead
